<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="pt-BR">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">
<title>CampusTotem | Mapa e acessibilidade da FAET</title>
<style>
/* Cores: azul do logo da UFMT + vermelho, amarelo e azul-céu em cor chapada */
:root{--indigo:#211b7c;--red:#d9261c;--yellow:#ffd400;--sky:#00a6e0;--ink:#111;--paper:#fff}
body.hc{--ink:#fff;--paper:#000}
*{box-sizing:border-box}
[hidden]{display:none!important}
html{font-size:20px}
body{margin:0;background:var(--paper);color:var(--ink);font-family:"Helvetica Neue",Helvetica,Arial,sans-serif;line-height:1.4;-webkit-tap-highlight-color:transparent;touch-action:manipulation;-webkit-user-select:none;user-select:none}
:focus-visible{outline:4px solid var(--ink);outline-offset:3px}
.page{max-width:1280px;margin:0 auto;padding:0 24px 32px}
.g{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(12,1fr);gap:24px}
.faixa{display:flex;height:16px}
.faixa i{flex:1}

/* blocos de cor chapada (fundo + texto legível) */
.c0{background:var(--ink);color:var(--paper)}
.c1{background:var(--indigo);color:#fff}
.c2{background:var(--red);color:#fff}
.c3{background:var(--yellow);color:#111}
.c4{background:var(--sky);color:#111}
body.hc .c1,body.hc .c2,body.hc .c3,body.hc .c4{background:#000;color:#ff0;box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 3px #ff0}

/* cabeçalho */
header{padding:24px 0 20px;align-items:end}
.tit{grid-column:span 8}
.ferr{grid-column:span 4;justify-self:end}
h1{font-size:clamp(3rem,9vw,6.2rem);font-weight:700;letter-spacing:-.045em;line-height:.92;margin:0}
.sub{margin:.7rem 0 0;font-size:1.2rem;font-weight:700}
.row{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:12px}
.btn{font-family:inherit;font-weight:700;font-size:1.05rem;color:var(--ink);background:var(--paper);border:3px solid var(--ink);min-height:60px;padding:8px 22px;cursor:pointer;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;text-decoration:none}
.btn[aria-pressed=true],.btn:active{background:var(--ink);color:var(--paper)}

/* início: foto e três ações */
.foto{grid-column:span 8;margin:0}
.foto img{display:block;width:100%;aspect-ratio:3/2;object-fit:cover}
.foto figcaption{font-size:.85rem;padding-top:6px}
.acoes{grid-column:span 4;display:grid;grid-template-rows:repeat(3,1fr);gap:12px}
.ac{font-family:inherit;border:0;text-align:left;cursor:pointer;text-decoration:none;display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:space-between;padding:14px 16px;min-height:110px}
.ac b{font-size:1.7rem;line-height:1.05;letter-spacing:-.02em}
.ac small{font-size:.9rem}
.ac:active{transform:scale(.98)}
.ac[aria-pressed=true]{box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 6px var(--ink)}

/* seções numeradas */
.sec{margin-top:40px;border-top:6px solid var(--ink);padding-top:12px}
.sec h2{font-size:2.2rem;letter-spacing:-.03em;line-height:1;margin:0 0 20px;display:flex;gap:16px;align-items:baseline}
.sec h2 span{color:var(--red)}
body.hc .sec h2 span{color:#ff0}

/* mapa e painel */
.mapa{grid-column:span 8}
.map{display:block;width:100%;height:auto;background:#efefef}
.road{fill:none;stroke:#fff;stroke-width:22}
.bld{cursor:pointer}
.bld text{font:700 17px "Helvetica Neue",Helvetica,Arial,sans-serif;pointer-events:none}
.b1 rect{fill:var(--indigo)}.b2 rect{fill:var(--red)}.b3 rect{fill:var(--yellow)}.b4 rect{fill:var(--sky)}
.b1 text,.b2 text{fill:#fff}.b3 text,.b4 text{fill:#111}
.bld rect{stroke:#111;stroke-width:0}
.bld:focus rect,.bld.on rect{stroke-width:7}
.rota{fill:none;stroke:#111;stroke-width:6;stroke-dasharray:2 12;stroke-linecap:round;animation:dash 1s linear infinite;display:none}
.rota.show{display:block}
@keyframes dash{to{stroke-dashoffset:-14}}
.ping{fill:none;stroke:#111;stroke-width:2;transform-box:fill-box;transform-origin:center;animation:ping 1.8s ease-out infinite}
@keyframes ping{from{transform:scale(1);opacity:1}to{transform:scale(2.8);opacity:0}}
.aqui{font:700 16px "Helvetica Neue",Helvetica,Arial,sans-serif;fill:#111;text-anchor:middle}
body.hc .map{background:#000}
body.hc .road{stroke:#333}
body.hc .bld rect{fill:#000;stroke:#ff0;stroke-width:2}
body.hc .bld text{fill:#ff0}
body.hc .bld.on rect{fill:#ff0}
body.hc .bld.on text{fill:#000}
body.hc .rota,body.hc .ping{stroke:#fff}
body.hc .aqui,body.hc .pto{fill:#fff}
.info{grid-column:span 4;align-self:start}
.info h3{margin:0;padding:14px 16px;font-size:1.6rem;line-height:1.1;letter-spacing:-.02em}
.info p{margin:14px 0}
.info ul{list-style:none;margin:0 0 16px;padding:0}
.info li{padding:8px 0;border-top:2px solid var(--ink);font-weight:700}
.info li:last-child{border-bottom:2px solid var(--ink)}

/* cartões do Street View: sem foto, fica o bloco de cor com o número */
.fotos{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(260px,1fr));gap:24px}
.sv{display:block;color:var(--ink);text-decoration:none}
.sv .img{position:relative;aspect-ratio:4/3;overflow:hidden;display:flex;align-items:flex-end;padding:12px;font-size:4.5rem;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:-.05em;line-height:1}
.sv img{position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover}
.sv span{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:8px;padding:10px 0;border-top:6px solid var(--ink);font-weight:700}
.sv:active{opacity:.75}

/* rodapé com a logo da UFMT */
footer{margin-top:40px;border-top:6px solid var(--ink);padding-top:20px;align-items:center}
.lg{grid-column:span 2}
.tx{grid-column:span 10}
footer img{display:block;height:120px;width:auto}
body.hc footer img{background:#fff;padding:6px}
footer b{display:block;font-size:2rem;letter-spacing:-.03em;line-height:1.05}

@media(max-width:860px){.tit,.ferr,.foto,.acoes,.mapa,.info,.lg,.tx{grid-column:span 12}.ferr{justify-self:start}.acoes{grid-template-rows:none}}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.rota,.ping{animation:none}}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<div class="faixa" aria-hidden="true"><i class="c1"></i><i class="c2"></i><i class="c3"></i><i class="c4"></i></div>
<div class="page">

<header class="g">
  <div class="tit">
    <h1>CampusTotem</h1>
    <p class="sub">Mapa e acessibilidade da FAET, UFMT Cuiabá</p>
  </div>
  <div class="ferr row" role="toolbar" aria-label="Ferramentas de acessibilidade">
    <button class="btn" id="mais" aria-label="Aumentar letras">A+</button>
    <button class="btn" id="menos" aria-label="Diminuir letras">A−</button>
    <button class="btn" id="hc" aria-pressed="false">Alto contraste</button>
  </div>
</header>

<main>
  <section class="g" aria-label="Início">
    <figure class="foto">
      <img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="Vista aérea do campus da UFMT em Cuiabá, com o lago, a praça do emblema e o estacionamento">
      <figcaption>Vista aérea do campus da UFMT em Cuiabá</figcaption>
    </figure>
    <nav class="acoes" aria-label="Ações principais">
      <a class="ac c3" id="gmaps" target="_blank" rel="noopener"><small>Abrir a localização da FAET</small><b>Google Maps</b></a>
      <a class="ac c2" id="street" target="_blank" rel="noopener"><small>Ver a FAET como se estivesse lá</small><b>Street View</b></a>
      <button class="ac c4" id="rota" aria-pressed="false"><small id="rotaTxt">Mostrar no mapa abaixo</small><b>Rota acessível</b></button>
    </nav>
  </section>

  <section class="sec" aria-labelledby="t1">
    <h2 id="t1"><span>01</span>Mapa da FAET</h2>
    <div class="g">
      <div class="mapa">
        <svg class="map" viewBox="0 0 600 380" role="group" aria-label="Mapa esquemático da FAET. Toque em um bloco para ver os detalhes.">
          <path class="road" d="M300 0V310M0 190H600M0 310H600"/>
          <g class="bld b1" data-id="a" tabindex="0" role="button" aria-label="Bloco A, laboratórios"><rect x="40" y="30" width="200" height="120"/><text x="60" y="130">Bloco A</text></g>
          <g class="bld b2" data-id="b" tabindex="0" role="button" aria-label="Bloco B, salas de aula"><rect x="360" y="30" width="200" height="120"/><text x="380" y="130">Bloco B</text></g>
          <g class="bld b3" data-id="c" tabindex="0" role="button" aria-label="Biblioteca"><rect x="40" y="225" width="200" height="60"/><text x="60" y="262">Biblioteca</text></g>
          <g class="bld b4" data-id="d" tabindex="0" role="button" aria-label="Cantina"><rect x="360" y="225" width="200" height="60"/><text x="380" y="262">Cantina</text></g>
          <path class="rota" d="M300 335V190M140 152V190H460V152M140 225V190M460 225V190"/>
          <circle class="ping" cx="300" cy="335" r="8"/>
          <circle class="pto" cx="300" cy="335" r="8" fill="#111"/>
          <text class="aqui" x="300" y="366">Você está aqui</text>
        </svg>
      </div>
      <aside class="info" aria-live="polite">
        <h3 id="nome" class="c0">Escolha um local</h3>
        <p id="desc">Toque em um bloco do mapa para ver o que há nele e quais recursos de acessibilidade oferece.</p>
        <ul id="rec"></ul>
        <button class="btn" id="ouvir">Ouvir</button>
      </aside>
    </div>
  </section>

  <section class="sec" aria-labelledby="t2">
    <h2 id="t2"><span>02</span>Veja a FAET no Street View</h2>
    <div class="fotos" id="fotos"></div>
  </section>
</main>

<footer class="g">
  <div class="lg"><img src="data:image/png;base64," alt="Logo da Universidade Federal de Mato Grosso"></div>
  <div class="tx"><b>Universidade Federal de Mato Grosso</b>Faculdade de Arquitetura, Engenharia e Tecnologia</div>
</footer>

</div>

<script>
// ===== EDITE AQUI =====
const LOCAL = "Faculdade de Arquitetura, Engenharia e Tecnologia, UFMT Campus Cuiabá, Av. Fernando Corrêa da Costa, 2367, Boa Esperança, Cuiabá - MT, 78060-900";
const CENTRO = "-15.6093,-56.0652"; // coordenada aproximada do campus: substitua pela exata
// Cada cartão: nome, foto (coloque o arquivo na pasta img/) e ponto do Street View.
// Para um ponto exato, troque c por "latitude,longitude" ou use u:"link copiado do Street View".
const PONTOS = [
  {n:"Fachada da FAET", img:"img/faet-fachada.jpg", c:CENTRO},
  {n:"Entrada e acesso", img:"img/faet-entrada.jpg", c:CENTRO},
  {n:"Entorno e estacionamento", img:"img/faet-entorno.jpg", c:CENTRO}
];
// Exemplo: troque pelos locais reais (a, b, c, d ligam cada texto ao bloco do mapa; k é a cor, de 1 a 4)
const BLOCOS = {
  a:{k:1, n:"Bloco A: Laboratórios", d:"Laboratórios de ensino e pesquisa, térreo e 1º andar.", t:["Rampa de acesso","Elevador","Piso tátil"]},
  b:{k:2, n:"Bloco B: Salas de aula", d:"Salas 101 a 120 e coordenação dos cursos.", t:["Rampa de acesso","Banheiro adaptado"]},
  c:{k:3, n:"Biblioteca", d:"Acervo, salas de estudo e computadores.", t:["Entrada nivelada","Elevador","Mesas adaptadas"]},
  d:{k:4, n:"Cantina", d:"Lanches, refeições e área de convivência.", t:["Entrada nivelada","Banheiro adaptado"]}
};
// ======================
const $=s=>document.querySelector(s), $$=s=>document.querySelectorAll(s);
const sv=p=>p.u||'https://www.google.com/maps/@?api=1&map_action=pano&viewpoint='+p.c;
$('#gmaps').href='https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query='+encodeURIComponent(LOCAL);
$('#street').href=sv(PONTOS[0]);
const COR=[1,2,4];
$('#fotos').innerHTML=PONTOS.map((p,i)=>
  '<a class="sv" target="_blank" rel="noopener" href="'+sv(p)+'"><div class="img c'+COR[i%3]+'">0'+(i+1)+'<img src="'+p.img+'" alt="'+p.n+'" onerror="this.remove()"></div><span><b>'+p.n+'</b><i>Abrir Street View</i></span></a>').join('');

function show(id){
  const b=BLOCOS[id];
  $$('.bld').forEach(g=>g.classList.toggle('on',g.dataset.id===id));
  $('#nome').className='c'+b.k; $('#nome').textContent=b.n; $('#desc').textContent=b.d;
  $('#rec').innerHTML=b.t.map(x=>'<li>'+x+'</li>').join('');
}
$$('.bld').forEach(g=>{
  g.onclick=()=>show(g.dataset.id);
  g.onkeydown=e=>{if(e.key==='Enter'||e.key===' '){e.preventDefault();show(g.dataset.id)}};
});

$('#rota').onclick=e=>{
  const on=e.currentTarget.getAttribute('aria-pressed')!=='true';
  e.currentTarget.setAttribute('aria-pressed',on);
  $('#rotaTxt').textContent=on?'Rota exibida no mapa abaixo':'Mostrar no mapa abaixo';
  $('.rota').classList.toggle('show',on);
};

let fs=20;
const setFs=d=>{fs=Math.min(28,Math.max(16,fs+d));document.documentElement.style.fontSize=fs+'px'};
$('#mais').onclick=()=>setFs(2);
$('#menos').onclick=()=>setFs(-2);
$('#hc').onclick=e=>e.currentTarget.setAttribute('aria-pressed',document.body.classList.toggle('hc'));

if(!('speechSynthesis' in window)) $('#ouvir').hidden=true;
$('#ouvir').onclick=()=>{
  speechSynthesis.cancel();
  const itens=[...$$('#rec li')].map(t=>t.textContent).join(', ');
  const u=new SpeechSynthesisUtterance($('#nome').textContent+'. '+$('#desc').textContent+' '+itens);
  u.lang='pt-BR'; speechSynthesis.speak(u);
};

// Quiosque: depois de 90 s sem toque, a página recarrega e volta ao estado inicial
let idle;
['pointerdown','keydown'].forEach(ev=>addEventListener(ev,()=>{clearTimeout(idle);idle=setTimeout(()=>location.reload(),90000)}));
</script>
</body>
</html>
